about: The cities Foodish covers. The robot (pipeline/cities.py) reads this file, and any app showing Foodish deals can too. To add a city: add an entry here, add it to CITIES in site/config.js, and if its province stopped changing clocks, add its fixed offset to pipeline/deal_state.py and site/deal-state.js; if it still changes clocks, set observes_dst to true. tests/test_cities.py checks they all agree. Each city has its own deals file at deals_url, in the same format; spec/deal-states.json explains how to tell whether a deal is on, using that city's local time.

cities.name: Edmonton
cities.covers: Edmonton plus St. Albert, Sherwood Park and Windermere
cities.utc_offset_note: Alberta stays on UTC-6 all year since 1 Nov 2026. Don't trust device time-zone data for this zone after that date.

cities.name: Vancouver
cities.covers: Vancouver plus Burnaby, Richmond, New Westminster, North Vancouver and West Vancouver
cities.utc_offset_note: British Columbia stays on UTC-7 all year since March 2026. Don't trust device time-zone data for this zone after 1 Nov 2026.

cities.name: Toronto
cities.covers: The City of Toronto: downtown, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke and East York
cities.utc_offset_note: Ontario still changes its clocks: UTC-5 from November to March, UTC-4 from March to November. Use normal time-zone data for this zone. utc_offset_hours here is the winter (standard) offset; each deals.json carries the offset in effect when it was made.
